subject: general
question: In June 2025, which ministry/institution released the Sustainable Development Goals – National Indicator Framework Progress Report, 2025?

options.text: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)** released the **Sustainable Development Goals – National Indicator Framework (NIF) Progress Report, 2025** in **June 2025**.
 
• The release of this report is traditionally scheduled to coincide with **National Statistics Day**, celebrated on **June 29** every year to mark the birth anniversary of **Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis**.
 
• The **National Indicator Framework (NIF)** serves as the primary institutional tool for monitoring the progress of **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** at the national level in India.
